incident: Auth tokens rejected due to clock skew
symptoms: valid JWTs were rejected as expired
multiple auth pods showed different system times
recent_changes: See root-cause context; synthetic historical incident.
root_cause: A subset of nodes had clock drift beyond the JWT tolerance window.
resolution: Clock drift caused valid JWTs to appear expired. Restoring NTP synchronization fixed validation without changing token policy.
postmortem: Key rotation would not fix time-based validation.
Longer token lifetime would mask the infrastructure issue.
